name: Bien vivre dans 16m²
evidence_locator: Project body paragraph beginning Sous la tablette de bureau
source_facts: Parents converted a former bathroom into a studio for their student son.
Architects describe a raised kitchen floor with bed stored underneath.
A lacquered wooden element on casters nests below the desk and serves as a coffee table when the bed is half extended as seating.
supported_decision: A mobile table can reuse under-desk storage space between activities.
